title: KESTRUM
subtitle: Every kingdom begins with a place.

text.map_no_receipt: No completed season yet · Income and upkeep appear after End Turn
text.map_unexplored_region: Armies discover nearby places. A City opens its Region for local actions.
text.map_pick_destination: Tap a destination to move or attack. Enemy defenders trigger battle.
text.map_move_in_region: Tap Enter Region at a City to inspect nearby places. Tap a connected place to travel there.
text.map_army_supply_cutoff: No friendly route to HQ: no recovery.
text.move_peaceful_border: Peace with {kingdom}. Tap Kingdom for war options.
text.peaceful_border_help: Peaceful borders are closed. Open Kingdom to review Declare War.
text.war_border_help: At war. Select an army, then a hostile site to advance; defenders trigger battle.
text.map_move_exhausted: No movement left. Tap a destination to save a route for End Turn.
text.move_planned_preview: This turn: {site}. Route continues next turn.
text.move_planned_destination: Route saved to {site}. Continues after End Turn when movement refreshes. Tap another place to change the route.
text.move_planned_notice: Route saved. Continues next turn when movement refreshes.
text.move_plan_encounter_notice: Stopped at an encounter. Review orders before continuing.
text.develop_city_help: Invest resources to establish a city while preserving its existing population and local state. Only a city opens its region.
text.city_development_success: City investment complete. Its region is now open.
text.facility_damaged: Facilities are not functional while structural damage is this high.
text.construction_no_orders: No work orders at this site or its connected routes.
text.construction_no_routes: No connected routes are available here.
text.construction_timing: Progress begins at the next eligible season end. Pauses keep existing progress.
text.construction_builder_help: Choose a local army. Each army can support one unfinished order; placement requires a nonempty force.
text.construction_no_builders: No friendly armies are at this work site. Move a nonempty army here first.
text.construction_builder_placement: The builder is released after placement. Facility work then needs ownership and supply.
text.construction_builder_remain: Keep the builder at the site or a road endpoint. Departure, combat or lost supply pauses work.
text.construction_builder_released: This work has ended and no longer reserves a builder.
text.construction_cancel_help: Cancelling ends this order. Unstarted work refunds its prepaid cost; work with any progress refunds nothing.
text.construction_success: Costs paid. Work begins at the next eligible season end.
text.construction_cancel_success: Order cancelled. Its eligible refund has been returned.
text.construction_builder_success: Replacement builder assigned. Existing progress is preserved.
text.construction_outpost_effect: Establishes an Outpost and transfers available settlers from supplied friendly settlements. Enables income and ordinary recruitment. Completion waits if no settlers are available.
text.construction_road_effect: Improves movement speed on this existing route. Supply still requires friendly controlled sites.
text.construction_repair_effect: Restores the improved road to zero damage, recovering its movement benefit.
text.construction_fort_effect: Adds Fort defenses while retaining the settlement habitation and population.
text.facility_stable_effect: Enables local Rider recruitment with horse access, supply and functional facilities.
text.facility_infirmary_effect: Enables local Medic recruitment while supplied and functional.
text.facility_workshop_effect: Enables local Siege Engine recruitment with a Fort, supply and functional facilities.
text.facility_training_effect: A place for ordinary training. It grants no current training or recruitment bonus.
text.facility_temple_effect: An ordinary civic and religious facility. It grants no current recruitment or mentoring bonus.
text.help_construction: Tap an owned place, then Manage. Build or Roads shows costs and seasonal steps before Confirm Build.
text.help_builder: Keep outpost, road and fort builders at work. Details explains pauses; Replace Builder preserves progress.
text.help_construction_refund: Cancel Order refunds unstarted work only. Focus affects local income, growth, repair or course prices; completed progress is kept.
text.move_observed_hostile: Hostile force present. Battle exhausts participants; defeated survivors retreat if an exit remains.
text.tutorial_headquarters: Your capital is {name}. Tap Show Capital, then Manage to review its development and city investment.
text.tutorial_city_find_capital: Tap Show Capital, then its Manage control to review Develop City.
text.tutorial_city_overview: On Overview, tap Develop City. The review shows its price and any condition that blocks investment.
text.tutorial_city_actions: Tap Develop City in Local Actions to review the payment and any blocker.
text.tutorial_city_review: Review the payment and any requirement shown. Confirm Action spends the listed resources and unlocks the capital's Region.
text.tutorial_city_blocked_review: This investment is blocked. Read the reason, then tap Back to return to Overview or Local Actions. Develop City stays available to review again.
text.tutorial_city_other_mode: Tap Overview or Local Actions, then select Develop City to review the investment.
text.tutorial_move_orders: Movement: tap Orders to choose your travelling army.
text.tutorial_move_begin: Tap Move Army, then a destination. Travel starts immediately.
text.tutorial_move_group: Choose your travelling armies, then tap Choose Destination.
text.tutorial_move_destination: Tap a connected destination to move immediately. Moving into an unclaimed place claims it. Bright rings show nearby costs; longer routes continue after End Turn.
text.tutorial_move_review: This route is blocked. Read the reason, use Review Route for details, or tap another destination.
text.tutorial_move_blocked: This destination is unavailable. Read the reason and tap another connected place.
text.tutorial_move_confirm: Check the route and cost, then tap Confirm Move. Only a successful order advances this step.
text.tutorial_find_army: Tap an Army marker on the map to move. Army Details opens its roster and people.
text.tutorial_back_roster: Tap Back to return to the roster, then Orders.
text.tutorial_back_map: Tap Back until the map is visible to continue the guide.
text.tutorial_region: Select your capital on the Country Map, then tap Enter Region.
text.tutorial_region_back_settlement: Tap Back to close Manage and return to the Country Map. Select your current capital, then tap Enter Region.
text.tutorial_region_return: Tap Country Map to return from this Region. Select your current capital, then tap Enter Region.
text.tutorial_region_city_required: Your current capital's Region is closed. Tap Show Capital, then Manage it and review Develop City; the blocker shows what needs fixing.
text.tutorial_world: Tap Country Map to return from the capital's local view.
text.tutorial_career_orders: Tap Orders, then People to inspect your named characters.
text.tutorial_people: Tap People to inspect local characters and their careers.
text.tutorial_career: Tap a person's Career to inspect earned evidence, training and recognition.
text.tutorial_household_open: Tap Households to inspect family choices and their requirements.
text.tutorial_household_back: Tap Back to reach People, then Households. Review a family choice before confirming.
text.tutorial_household_review: Select local people and tap a choice to review it. Invite Apprentice also opens a review. Confirmation is optional.
text.tutorial_turn: Tap End Turn when ready. Rivals act next and attack neighbors weaker than themselves, so keep your armies strong. Pause, Step and Resume control their progress.
text.tutorial_npc: Rivals are acting. Use Pause, Step or Resume below; Menu > Records opens witnessed history.
text.tutorial_npc_back: Rival turn: tap Back to the map, then use Pause, Step or Resume to control their progress.
text.tutorial_threat: Bandits or wildlife hold places near {name}. Tap a threat beside your army, then Clear Threat. Victory pays a reward and opens the route.
text.tutorial_raise_army: One army cannot claim land and guard {name}. Tap Show Capital, open Armies and choose New Army to raise a second force.
text.tutorial_records: Tap Menu, then Records for witnessed battles and dated biographies. This completes the guide.
text.hero_progress_detail: Personal Hero service: {progress}/{total} qualifying engagements fought while fit
text.person_founding_lord: Founding lord of {kingdom} · +{bonus} leadership points while fit and in command.
text.setup_founding_lord: A named young lord, aged {minimum}–{maximum}, founds your kingdom and leads your first army.
text.commander_any_adult: Any fit adult attached to the army may command; Officers add the leadership bonus.
text.course_pause_help: Courses pause if a person moves, is wounded, or loses local facility access.
text.formation_course_pause_help: Training pauses if the army moves or leaves its training ground.
text.elder_choice_help: Keep command or choose mentorship, governance or retirement.
text.mentorship_help: Four shared seasons complete an apprenticeship. Lessons add discipline only, never battle or encounter records.
text.mentorship_no_teacher: No qualified teacher is available at this supplied site with the needed facility.
text.automatic_retirement_notice: Retired from field service at age 70: {names}.
text.records_help: Inspect your service, public places, encountered people, and your faction’s heirlooms.
text.history_retention_help: Records preserve known events. Older details may be unavailable; earned capabilities remain.
text.history_last_known_help: Dated observations only. Later changes and current whereabouts are unknown.
text.history_empty: No retained records match this selection. Older history may be unavailable.
text.history_own_person: Your person · current service and condition
text.history_filter_help: Filter this subject’s retained events by type and inclusive season range.
text.history_search_help: Search your people and recorded encounter names. Clear the name to show everyone known.
text.history_report_expired: Detailed battle report is no longer retained.
text.history_item_no_bonus: A name and history; no combat bonus
text.history_item_deeds_help: Later custody changes appear in the item's, holder's and site's chronicles. Detailed deeds expire after 40 seasons.
text.history_item_collect_help: Collect this estate item at the same site.
text.history_no_hidden_facts: Only your people and witnessed encounters can be inspected.
text.history_no_inherited_deeds: Joining a formation does not grant its earlier deeds. Only supported personal service is counted.
text.service_recovery_help: Recovery preserves earned experience and tier. Destruction ends this formation’s veteran identity.
text.service_no_evidence_help: Service comes from actual encounters. Reading records and recovering troops grant no experience.
text.help_service: Orders opens Formation Service. Actual participation earns veterancy; recovery preserves it.
text.help_history: Records in Menu opens known people, places and armies. Filters selects event types and seasons.
text.help_knowledge: Nearby enemies reveal presence only. Last Encountered shows dated facts; later changes stay unknown.
text.help_careers: Career opens each named person's earned evidence and courses. Begin a course at its supplied local facility; Practice Riding takes one season.
text.help_history_knowledge: Records in Menu opens known people, places and armies. Filters event types and seasons. Nearby enemies reveal presence only; Last Encountered shows dated facts.
text.help_notifications: Open Notifications in the rail to review dated events. Show on map moves to a currently available subject; View person, Manage place and Records open current views. Settings controls only change future delivery.
text.observer_setup_intro: Set the number of kingdoms and a world seed, then watch their decisions unfold.
text.observer_session_note: This is a temporary session. No saves are created; Main Menu returns to your previous campaign.
text.observer_factions_help: Choose between 4 and 8 kingdoms. Every kingdom is controlled by AI.
text.observer_all_ai: A world with no player kingdom
text.observer_full_visibility: Every kingdom, claim, settlement, and army is visible throughout the campaign.
text.observer_tutorial: Drag the map to pan. Tap Pause to stop after the current order. While paused, tap Step for one order. Select 1×, 2×, or 4× for speed. Tap Kingdoms to inspect the realm list.
text.observer_roster_help: Tap a kingdom to center the map on its headquarters.
text.observer_log_empty: No notable events yet. Wars, territory changes, battles and new people appear here.
text.help_army: Select your headquarters, then Armies to review its six-slot roster.
text.help_recruit: Recruit fills a free slot. New Army creates a separate force at this site.
text.help_slots: Select a troop type, read its cost and requirements, then Confirm Recruit.
text.help_economy: Each round earns income, then pays upkeep. A shortfall blocks recruitment.
text.help_disband: Select a formation, then Orders and Disband. Confirmation removes it with no refund.
text.help_claim: Moving an army into an unclaimed place takes it and adds its income. Holdings cut off from your headquarters pay only half their income, so expand along connected routes.
text.help_move: Tap an Army marker, then a destination. Tap a hostile place to advance; defenders trigger battle. At peaceful borders, tap Kingdom to review Declare War. End Turn continues saved routes.
text.help_route: Country routes connect places. Enter Region exposes nearby targets and retains saved orders. Review Route lists each step; Cancel Route stops a plan.
text.help_transfer: Transfer Formation or People chooses a local recipient. Split into New Army moves one formation.
text.help_spent: Transfers keep movement spent. Recruits wait one round; groups move at their slowest pace.
text.help_recovery: Supply and paid upkeep allow up to 20% recovery each round. Gold pays for actual replacements.
text.help_transfer_phase: Opening Armies pauses rival orders for transfers. Return to the map and Resume when ready.
text.move_group_help: Select armies at this physical site. The group uses its slowest member's remaining movement.
text.move_enter_region: Enter this place's region to select a physical site. Only Cities have regions; entrances have their own travel costs.
text.move_uncertain_contact: Battle may stop travel and exhaust your forces. Defeat forces retreat; no exit destroys the army.
text.move_route_clear: The full route is currently available. Confirmation rechecks each edge.
text.move_supplied_after: If secured on arrival, this site connects to your headquarters.
text.move_unsupplied_after: The stopping site is outside your supply. Normal recovery is unavailable there.
text.move_pick_destination: Tap a connected place to preview your route. Nearby reachable places show their movement cost. Moving reveals more of the map.
text.family_review_form: Both adults need {age} years of age and {seasons} recorded shared-service seasons at this safe settlement. Close relatives and people with an active household cannot form another.
text.family_review_adopt: A living adult guardian may adopt a local ward for one population. A guardian household can have at most two dependent children.
text.family_review_children: Partners aged twenty to forty must share their safe home. Raising children allows a sparse chance each spring; pausing keeps the existing family together.
text.family_review_end: End this partnership. Both people, their dependents and recorded kinship remain in the campaign.
text.family_review_train: A fit dependent Recruit aged thirteen to sixteen may begin local training at a safe settlement.
text.family_review_service: A fit dependent or trainee Recruit aged seventeen or older may enter service at this safe settlement. Assign them to a local formation afterwards.
text.family_review_invite: Invite a local adult for {gold} Gold and one population at an owned, supplied Village. This is available once per year when the faction has no dependents and no deficit.
text.family_review_designate: Choose a real relationship and one legacy category. The successor must meet that category's requirements through their own service. This designation does not copy skills or statistics.
text.family_review_ready: All current requirements are met. Confirm to issue this order.
text.households_help: Select local people, then tap an action to review its requirements. The review explains blocked choices before you confirm an order.
text.legacy_help: Select a predecessor and successor, then choose a real relationship and legacy category. Command successors must already serve in the same army.
text.vacant_succession_notice: After {predecessor} left, command of {army} is vacant.
text.recovery_forecast: If current conditions remain at round end.
text.transfer_preserves_movement: Transfers are free and preserve all movement already spent.
text.transfer_paused_help: Rival orders are paused. Transfers are available; moving and disbanding wait for your turn.
text.people_transfer_help: Choose a person at this physical site to transfer to another friendly formation.
text.no_local_people: No named people at this site
text.transfer_choose_army: Choose a co-located army, then its destination slot or formation.
text.person_needs_formation: Empty slot — choose a surviving formation
text.help_battle: Hostile field contact opens saved preparation. Accept the battle before the encounter commits.
text.help_battle_reports: Menu > Records > Battle Reports reopens recorded outcomes, forces, people and factors without changing play.
text.help_wounds: Wounded people give no field leadership. Two supplied rounds restore their fitness.
text.battle_recorded: Recorded encounter. Enemy details describe what was observed at this battle.
text.battle_tactic_fallback: Fallback: Attack if possible, else Wait.
text.no_battle_reports: No battles have been witnessed by your forces.
text.battle_annihilation: One side had no surviving combatants.
text.battle_rout: A side reached the rout threshold
text.battle_exchange_limit: The exchange limit decided the result
text.battle_exhausted: All participants spent their remaining movement.
text.battle_person_died_wipe: Died when the formation was destroyed.
text.battle_person_no_refuge: Died after the formation was destroyed; no friendly refuge was available.
text.battle_wound_wipe: Survived the formation's destruction with wounds
text.no_battle_people: No named people took part in this battle
text.battle_simultaneous_detail: Both sides attack from the exchange's starting forces. Losses are then applied together; overkill is not reassigned.
text.help_leadership: Named officers strengthen an army. Recruits wait until next round to move.
text.recruit_success: Formation recruited. It becomes ready next round.
text.new_army_help: Recruit a formation to establish a new army here. Its six slots can hold different troop types.
text.upkeep_deficit: Upkeep shortfall: recruitment is blocked until a later round pays upkeep in full.
text.recruit_exhausted: New formations are exhausted until the next round.
text.disband_warning: Disband this formation? Its troops leave service. Recruitment costs are not refunded.
text.disband_people: Named people stay at this site, joining another friendly formation when available.
text.disband_last: This is the army's last formation. Disbanding removes the empty army.
text.help_pan: Drag the landscape with one finger or the left mouse button to pan.
text.help_zoom: Pinch to zoom, or tap + and -. Overview shows known land; Return View restores your previous camera. Recenter focuses your selected army or home.
text.help_turn: End Turn finishes your orders. After all factions act, the season advances and saves.
text.help_menu: Tap Menu for Save Game or Load Game. Each round keeps its own checkpoint.
text.help_scope: Rivals recruit, build, expand and wage war through ordinary orders. Kingdom decisions can pause their progress.
text.help_select: Tap Army to move or a place to inspect. Your home area is revealed first; armies discover nearby places as they travel. Discoveries are saved.
text.help_region: Only Cities have Regions. Select an available City marker, then Enter Region to inspect nearby places. Country Map returns to the country view.
text.help_navigation: Drag to pan. Pinch or tap + / - to zoom. Overview fits known land; Return View restores your working view. Recenter focuses your selected army or home.
text.help_map_scales: Overview: kingdom borders and urgent activity. Campaign: routes and compact forces. Detail: local names and costs. Tap a numbered circle of places to focus.
text.help_map_symbols: Crown: capital. Shape: place. Fill: physical control on Country Map and in local regions. Ring: control. /: occupation. X: contested. !: known danger. Select for details.
text.help_map_contacts: Flag: force. R with outer ring: forces across a region. +: nearby group; tap to focus. A plain count: armies at one site. >: saved route. ! on a flag: siege or cut off; select for exact details.
text.select_place: Tap an Army marker to move, or a place to inspect.
text.anchors_help: Supply must reach your headquarters through secure friendly sites.
text.credits_title: A world waiting for its history

text.new_warning: Start a new campaign? Your saved campaigns remain available. Unsaved orders in the current game will be left behind.
text.setup_intro: 152 places, no starting Regions. Invest to make Cities and open Regions. Rivals begin at peace.
text.setup_name_help: Enter a trimmed kingdom name of up to 32 characters. The touch keyboard is available below.
text.setup_factions_help: Every rival starts with the same troops, resources and nearby local threats.
text.npc_prototype: Rivals issue legal orders; Step performs one order
text.legacy_read_only: The old atlas is read-only. Start New Game for a strategic campaign.
text.no_catalogue_saves: No saved campaigns yet. During your orders, tap New Save to keep a named copy.
text.overwrite_warning: Confirm replacing the selected save with your current campaign. Other saves remain available.
text.save_name_help: Name this save using the keys below, or type a name. Up to 40 characters.
text.delete_warning: Delete this saved campaign? This cannot be undone. Your current game remains open.
text.round_unsaved_help: Your current progress is still in memory. Retry saves this same moment without repeating any orders or seasonal effects. Continue Unsaved returns to play.
text.storage_ready: Select a save to load, overwrite or delete. New Save always keeps a separate copy.
text.storage_busy: Another window is using these saves. Close it, then tap Retry Storage.
text.save_during_orders: New saves and overwrites are available during your orders.
text.siege_enemy_unknown: Enemy strength and named participants are revealed by actual combat.
text.siege_maintain_help: Keep the siege in place. Walls weaken once at an eligible season end; this order adds no immediate progress.
text.siege_assault_help: Selected besiegers attack every defender behind the walls. A failed or drawn assault leaves surviving besiegers outside.
text.siege_withdraw_help: Move selected besiegers to one legal adjacent exit. When the last besieger leaves, the siege lifts.
text.siege_sortie_help: Selected defenders attack all besiegers without wall protection. A failed or drawn sortie falls back inside with surviving forces.
text.siege_escape_help: Fight all besiegers without walls. Only victory takes selected survivors to the chosen exit; a draw or defeat falls back inside.
text.siege_battle_risk: Every participant is exhausted. Casualties persist. Unselected defenders stay inside; an empty garrison lets surviving besiegers capture the site.
text.siege_no_exit: There is no legal adjacent exit.
text.siege_ended: This siege has ended. Return to the map to inspect control and surviving armies.
text.move_possible_siege: A defended fort starts a siege; an undefended fort can be secured. Arrival exhausts the besieging force.
text.move_join_siege: Arrival joins your besiegers outside the walls. No free move through the siege; arriving armies are exhausted.
text.move_relief: Relief fights all besiegers without walls; fit garrison armies join. On defeat or draw, relief retreats and the garrison stays inside.
text.help_siege: Tap a besieged place, then Siege. Select your armies and tap Choose Siege Order to inspect the legal choices.
text.help_siege_choices: Assault fights through walls; Sortie fights outside. Withdraw or Escape selects an exit before Confirm Siege Order.
text.help_relief: Move an outside army to your besieged site to relieve it. Review Route explains the joint battle before Confirm Move.
text.battle_siege_positions: Each army below records its actual survivors and final position. Returning inside or remaining outside does not restore casualties.
text.battle_walls_help: Only assaults use wall protection. Surviving siege engines reduce it; each exchange records its applied factor.
text.siege_assault_risk: Every participant is exhausted. Casualties persist. Surviving attackers capture the site only after defeating the garrison.
text.rename_place_help: Choose a name of 1–40 characters. The place keeps its identity and history.
text.resettle_help: Move up to 50 displaced people to a safe, reachable friendly place with room. Population is transferred once.
text.move_capital_help: Make this safe, supplied Town or larger place your capital. Its political role changes; headquarters and population stay independent.
text.relocate_hq_help: Make this place your single headquarters and supply root. Requires a Village or larger, Training Ground and friendly army. Available once in four seasons.
text.resettle_no_destination: No safe reachable friendly destination has room for displaced people.
text.threat_none_adjacent: No observed local threat is adjacent to this army.
text.threat_unavailable: This threat is no longer present or observed.
text.threat_no_armies: Bring an army to a connected adjacent site to clear this threat.
text.threat_choose_armies: Choose adjacent armies from one origin. Exact threat strength is learned in combat.
text.threat_review_risk: Attack through the adjacent route. Combat is automatic; all participants exhaust their remaining movement. Casualties and surviving threats persist.
text.threat_reward_once: A cleared threat pays its reward only once. Reopening its report grants nothing.
text.threat_combat_rules: Neutral leadership: 100%. Threats cannot retreat; routed remnants are destroyed.
text.help_development: Manage shows pressure, population and the conditions behind growth or decline. Growth reaches Town; a City needs a separate resource investment. Focus changes one local priority.
text.help_local_actions: Manage > Local Actions offers Develop City, Rename, Resettle, Move Capital and Relocate HQ. Review the cost, then Confirm Action.
text.help_threats: Tap an observed threat, then Clear Threat. Select adjacent armies, Review Expedition and Confirm Clear Threat. Every few years bandits raid exposed holdings of large realms.
text.focus_effect_growth: Growth adds 2 development pressure each season. Population and geography limit habitation; a City needs a separate resource investment.
text.focus_effect_fortification: Safe supplied places repair 5 extra fort damage each season. This does not build a fort.
text.focus_effect_training: Local class and formation courses cost 25% less Gold, with the total rounded up when ordered. Courses still advance once per eligible season.
text.focus_effect_gold: Adds 25% to local base Gold income, after damage and occupation modifiers.
text.focus_effect_wood: Adds 25% to local base Wood income where forests or Wood Source permit it.
text.focus_effect_stone: Adds 25% to local base Stone income where hills or Stone Source permit it.
text.resettle_no_people: There are no displaced people to resettle from this place.
text.site_income_unknown: Last local income: no recorded assessment.
text.site_income_stopped: No local income: ruin, siege or local threat.
text.kingdom_scope: Relations and sovereign decisions. Enemy forces remain unknown until encountered.
text.kingdom_defeat_help: This rival has no surviving army or functioning Outpost or larger settlement. Choose its permanent outcome.
text.kingdom_incoming_help: A peace offer awaits your response. Normal orders pause until you decide.
text.kingdom_inactive_help: This kingdom no longer issues independent orders.
text.temperament_balanced_help: Grows steadily and fights only rivals it can match.
text.temperament_aggressive_help: Keeps extra armies and starts wars on slim odds.
text.temperament_defensive_help: Stays near home, guards borders, rarely starts wars.
text.temperament_peaceful_help: Never declares war and seeks peace in every war.
text.temperament_expansionist_help: Claims distant land and prefers settling to war.
text.declare_war_help: Declare war on this kingdom. Hostile movement and combat become legal; peaceful borders never declare war automatically.
text.offer_peace_help: Ask for peace once per pair each round. Agreement ends mutual sieges and starts four rounds of non-aggression. Forces must have legal withdrawal routes.
text.accept_peace_help: Agree to peace and four rounds of non-aggression. Mutual sieges lift and forces withdraw to legal adjacent places. The agreement fails if any force cannot withdraw.
text.decline_peace_help: Decline this offer. The war continues and no forces withdraw.
text.annex_help: Permanently eliminate the defeated kingdom. Captured places remain with their current controllers. Annexation grants no extra resources or recruits.
text.submission_help: Accept this kingdom as your direct subordinate. It has no independent armies, orders or income and cannot revive. This grants no extra resources or recruits.
text.peace_agreed: Peace agreed. Forces have withdrawn where required.
text.kingdom_victory_help: Every other founding kingdom is eliminated or directly subordinate to yours. This kingdom campaign has reached its ending.
text.kingdom_defeat_end_help: Your kingdom has no surviving army or functioning Outpost or larger settlement. Its campaign has ended.
text.kingdom_ending_readonly: This ending is permanent in this save. Explore its records, save this moment or start a new campaign.
text.help_diplomacy: Menu > Kingdom shows public relations. Declare War or Offer Peace opens a confirmation with current restrictions.
text.help_kingdom_decisions: Peace offers and defeated rivals pause orders. Kingdom Decision opens their choices. You can save before responding.
text.help_kingdom_ending: Conquer or subordinate every rival to reach the kingdom ending. Records, saves and New Game remain available; no further turns run.
text.help_aging: Age advances on birthdays. Light Cavalry movement caps at 8 from age 41.
text.help_aging_choices: At 56, only an appointed commander contributes; current command stays until reassigned. Elders can mentor or govern.
text.help_retirement: Mortality is checked on birthdays from age 60. Adults may retire locally. Field service ends at 70; Kestrum seeks the nearest safe owned settlement.
text.help_mentorship: Mentors are 26+, class-qualified, and have four service seasons in a discipline. Learners may start at 13.
text.help_mentorship_contact: Meet at one physical site that is supplied, safe and developed. Its facility is required; Riding also needs Horse Access.
text.help_apprenticeship: Injury, separation or lost access pauses lessons. Two seasons open an alternate class path; four complete it. Lessons grant no battle evidence.
text.help_households: Two unpartnered adults need four shared service seasons at a safe owned settlement. Births are sparse yearly spring chances. Wards use one population unit; trainees begin at thirteen and field service at seventeen.
text.help_succession: Blood, adoption, mentorship and local office establish different successor links. A designation moves neither people nor skills. Command successors must already serve in their commander's army; vacancies prefer local pupils, then command evidence.
text.help_heirlooms: Founding officers begin with a named sword. Transfer or collect it only at the same site. History follows one item identity, shows dated custody deeds and current era, and reports when earlier detail has been forgotten.
text.life_apprentice: Entered local service as an apprentice
